photos.name: img-8653
photos.summary: Two unbaked bun rounds on plastic wrap — one standing on edge to show the spiral cross-section, one flat showing the cinnamon sugar swirl from above. Shaping stage, just after cutting strips.

photos.name: img-8655
photos.summary: Rolled dough sheet on a silicone baking mat, fully coated with cinnamon sugar filling and cut into vertical strips using the strip-cut method; chef's knife and rolling pin visible at right. Pre-roll shaping stage.

photos.name: img-8656
photos.summary: Overhead view of the filling-coated dough rectangle with uniform vertical strips scored across the full width, rolling pin and knife resting alongside on the mat. Strip-cut shaping stage.

photos.name: img-8657
photos.summary: Eight shaped buns arranged in two columns in a glass baking dish, unbaked, each showing a tight cinnamon sugar spiral. Pre-bake proofing stage.

photos.name: img-8658
photos.summary: Eight fully baked buns in the glass dish straight from the oven, deeply golden with dark cinnamon spirals; the two front-left buns are partially glazed with white cream cheese icing mid-application. Glazing stage.
